evidence_kind: manual source inspection; current worktree review, not final committed binary certification
material_limits: No proof of attacker minimum fresh neural work. Prepared canonical claims can expose correct business products; seal work does not imply new neural computation.
One trusted owner/protected journal/fixed epoch only. File locking is per file; same policy can be used in another file. No global anti-clone or whole-database rollback guarantee.
CPU, GPU, energy, capital and whole-service work lower bounds are unproved; logical MACs do not establish hardware costs.
Native runtime evidence must be rebuilt and tied to the final source commit and executable hash by the root campaign.
All example keys are public test fixtures under common control. Independent operators, external funded demand and actual application consumer use remain unestablished.
Canonical clock uses host wall time plus immutable anchor; trusted clock is an assumption and cross-run/host rollback resistance is not established.

Transport raw.len is retained frame bytes: temporary BufReader may prefetch/discard trailing bytes. One controlled frame per connection is accounted; malicious trailing-stream/whole-wire totals are not measured.
write_all failure reports unknown partial sent bytes; kernel acceptance does not prove client application consumption.
Owner raw replies and timing/error stages are observable; hidden verifier feedback assumption has not been proved.
Reopen/startup recomputes direct business observations and model merging outside K; repeat startup/parse/signature/transport costs are not globally capped.
